sourceFile: 43.1 TIU C11-20  Report Test Keep sample and hearing again 2026.1.26_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source context but misgroups the changed factor and incomplete or invalid outcome extraction.
issues: Changed factor should center on Mold KR MAKE, not hearing/audiobus test times.
Baseline condition is not explicit in the cited sheet.
Later repeated result blocks are omitted from outcomes.
Measurement outcomes appear derived from headers/mixed columns, not valid measurements.
Decision content is not cited or captured.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended comparison the KR MAKE mold change versus a prior mold/baseline?
Should hearing/audiobus retest rounds be treated as subgroups rather than changed factors?
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to Mold KR MAKE from the content row.
Mark baseline as not shown unless an external baseline is supplied.
Regroup Audiobus/Hearing time 1 and 2 as test-round subresults.
Extract all result rows across the full table, including later blocks.
Remove invalid measurement-stat outcomes and cite the decision row if populated.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but semantic evidence is insufficient for final use until regrouped.
